newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa could push higher, base prepared.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa could push higher, base prepared.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa futures look to have built enough of a support base to mount a challenge on the first of last month's peaks at 1,052 stg basis September, technical analysts said on Friday.
The London market was called to open broadly unchanged from Thursday's close.

Although the September contract closed at session lows, touching a three-week trendline extending up from last month's 965 stg low, analysts said the fact that 1,000 stg was intact was constructive for prices.
"If it holds anywhere above 1,000 it still looks good and there's the possibility of it heading up," said Darren Gurner, technical analyst at Sucden.

If September could muster enough momentum it was likely to target a series of intraday highs scored last month at 1,052, 1,063 and 1,087 -- the bottom of a chart gap leading up to the contract high at 1,170 stg.
"We can start talking about a market which looks as if it really could go for 1,052 and 1,063," Gurner said.
Other analysts have been more cautious, saying that while September seemed well supported at the lower range end, the potential to break higher could be limited.
Support was placed around the 1,014 close and also at the 20-day moving average, currently at 1,009 stg.
Fundamentally the London and New York markets were awaiting the next round of crop reports for a better indication of the size of the 1997/98 main crop from Ivory Coast.
